statusDetail: Cloudflare security verification prevented access to Letterboxd. This retained run is coverage-incomplete and has no score.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare’s “Just a moment…” verification page was reachable; the Letterboxd page architecture could not be profiled.

artifacts.caption: Desktop capture showing Cloudflare security verification instead of Letterboxd.
Rendered DOM and computed CSS from the Cloudflare challenge page.
Recon probe recording title, challenge text, links, and robots.txt response.
Atomic manifest of all 58 expected principle/check pairs from the pinned catalog.
Coverage validator output showing the publication gate failed because all 58 checks were blocked.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted fresh Chrome navigation followed by screenshot, rendered-DOM inspection, and evaluate-based route/content recon on https://letterboxd.com/.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A fresh headless Chrome navigation was intercepted by a Cloudflare security-verification page titled “Just a moment…” rather than the Letterboxd application. The attempted screenshot, rendered-DOM inspection, and in-page recon probe could not reach site content or representative routes.
checkOutcomes.reason: External Cloudflare bot verification blocked access to the target application, so this check could not be executed against Letterboxd.
